column30: Seida Station is an important railway junction. Beyond Seida, the railway splits into two branches. One leads to the town of Labytnangi, the other to Vorkuta. Before this junction, there is another small station, Chum, but due to the lack of a waiting room, it is not popular with passengers who need to transfer to another railway line.
